posts.topic_title: Keep Covered When Not in Use
posts.author: Tony
posts.post_subject: Keep Covered When Not in Use
posts.content_md:
In order to keep dust off of optics, I suggest this product:

[http://www.saran.ca/saran_quickcovers.asp](http://www.saran.ca/saran_quickcovers.asp)

They are like disposable 'shower hats' with elastic rims. Perfect for keeping dust off that 8" collimating mirror!
